title: GEARS XR with Simulation Chapters
description: Browser and WebXR molecular dynamics viewer that detects bond-change events in trajectories, suggests names for them with a local language model checked against the detected bonds, and records a scientist's accept or reject decision as labelled data. Includes the Transition1x-based benchmark, baseline comparisons with ReacNetGenerator and LAMMPS fix reaxff/species, and the test suite.
